page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It features 16.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 4.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance operates in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is measured at 1102.59, while the multi-core performance reaches 2912.92, both falling into the bottom 25% category. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with large-block read-only operations registering at 19.5 GB/sec and write operations at 18.08 GB/sec. Geekbench scores further reflect these constraints, showing a single-core score of 914.0 and a multi-core score of 1989.0.

Because the instance lacks local storage, workloads must rely entirely on network-attached storage. Given its dedicated CPU resources combined with modest processing and memory throughput, the instance offers a predictable but low-performance profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without high-performance demands. Suitable workloads include lightweight static web serving, basic database operations, and development or testing environments.
